I forgot that the default Godot builds were optimized in my previous suggestion to compile with `debug_symbols=yes`. Could you compile with `scons dev_build=yes` (equivalent to `debug_symbols=yes optimize=none` and a few other minor options)?

Note that the resulting binary will be named with a `.dev` suffix: `godot.linuxbsd.editor.dev.x86_64`

So interestingly unoptimized builds don't seem to crash, so optimization level seems to play a role there.

So it's crashing here:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/45fc515ae3574e9c1f9deacaa6960dec68a7d38b/platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp#L4580

`ss->wl_data_device` is null, and this is checked above, but unlike other checks, it doesn't return:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/45fc515ae3574e9c1f9deacaa6960dec68a7d38b/platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp#L4567-L4569

Adding the `return` should prevent the crash, though I don't know if it's expected for `wl_data_device` to be null here.
